title: Never Looks Nice
text: Never Looks Nice. This is a huge bag. You fill it with your stuffed animals and sit on it. It takes a lot of stuffed animals to fill this thing! The irregular shape of the stuffed animals makes it never look like the picture. In fact, it usually just looks like a giant canvas bag in the floor. I love the idea, but this shape was entirely impractical for the task.
